name: Air2
purpose: Treble exciter: three boost bands (hiss, glitter, air) plus a Silk control that adds soft harmonics to the highs; adds sparkle EQ cannot.

params.name: Hiss
params.ai_hint: Upper-treble band. 0.5 is off; 0.6-0.7 adds a little sheen, below 0.5 cuts. Start at 0.5 on a vocal and use the Air band first.

params.name: Glitter
params.ai_hint: Mid-treble band. 0.5 is off; 0.55-0.65 adds clarity; be careful, it adds harshness when pushed on vocals.

params.name: Air
params.ai_hint: Broad air band, the softest and prettiest of the three. 0.5 is off; 0.6-0.8 is typical for vocal air.

params.name: Silk
params.ai_hint: Silk: soft harmonics added to the highs. 0 is off; 0.2-0.5 gives a smooth, expensive top end.

params.name: Dry/Wet
params.ai_hint: Up to 0.75 you keep the full dry signal and add the effect on top; above 0.75 the dry fades out. 0.5-0.75 for normal use.

notes: Upstream description: Air2 is a different bright EQ with silk tone and high sample rate support.
All Airwindows parameters are 0..1; the three bands display as (value*2)-1, so 0.5 is neutral.
Unlike Air, Air2 works at high sample rates.
Place after the de-esser so it does not exaggerate sibilance.
CPU: 0.20% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
